citations.text: A candidate shall be required to put in a minimum of seventy-five percent (75%) of attendance in each course, computed on the total number of periods of instruction held in that course during the semester, in order to be eligible to appear for the semester end examination in that course. A candidate who fails to secure the required seventy-five percent (75%) attendance in any course shall be detained in that course and shall not be permitted to appear for the semester end examination therein.

A minimum attendance of eighty percent (80%) in the pre-placement training programme shall be mandatory. A candidate failing to secure such attendance may be declared ineligible for campus recruitment at the discretion of the Training and Placement Officer.

Condonation of shortage of attendance to the extent of ten percent (10%), that is, for candidates securing attendance of not less than sixty-five percent (65%) and less than seventy-five percent (75%) in a course, may be granted by the Principal on the recommendation of the Head of the Department, on genuine and verifiable medical grounds, and on payment of the condonation fee prescribed by the College. Application for condonation shall be made in the prescribed form together with supporting medical certification, not later than ten days before the commencement of the semester end examinations.

A candidate shall be declared to have passed a course if the candidate secures not less than forty percent (40%) of the marks in the semester end examination and not less than forty percent (40%) of the marks in the aggregate of internal evaluation and semester end examination taken together.
A candidate detained under clause 4.2 for want of attendance shall be required to re-register for and repeat the course concerned in a subsequent semester in which the course is offered.
Every candidate shall register for the courses of a semester within the dates notified by the Office of the Controller of Examinations. Late registration shall attract a fee as prescribed.

The attendance position of every candidate shall be displayed on the College notice board and the student portal at the end of each month. Any representation regarding the attendance so displayed shall be made within seven working days of such display, after which the attendance recorded shall be treated as final.
